entry: Started the week with a long college day. NLP lecture on transformers was interesting but I couldn't follow the attention maths fully. Came home tired and slept early.
Had a group meeting for our final year project. We finally agreed on the module split and I got the frontend. Felt good that things are moving.
Assignment deadline tomorrow and I haven't started the report. Spent the whole evening panicking and writing. Barely slept.
Submitted the assignment two minutes before the deadline. Relieved but exhausted. Skipped lunch because of it.
Friday! Went out for pani puri with friends after college and laughed a lot. Best part of the week.
Lazy Saturday. Watched a movie, played BGMI with my squad for a few hours and won two matches. Very relaxed.
Cleaned my room and planned next week. Feeling a little anxious about the internship interview on Tuesday.
Prepared for the interview all day — revised DSA, SQL and my projects. Nervous but more confident than yesterday.
Interview day. The technical round went okay but I blanked on one question about indexing. Worried I messed it up.
No news from the company yet. Couldn't focus in class, kept checking my email. Feeling low.
Got a mail that I cleared the first round! Danced in my room. Called mom and she was so happy.
Productive day — finished the dataset cleaning for the forecasting project and the jury liked our progress.
Diwali preparations at home. Made rangoli with my sister and ate too many sweets. Very happy and festive.
Diwali! Family, lights, crackers and lots of photos. One of the happiest days this month.
Back to college after the festival. Hard to get back into routine, felt sleepy all day.
Lab exam today. My code had an error at the start but I fixed it in time and the examiner was impressed.
Argument with a teammate about who would present the project. It got heated and I felt irritated the whole evening.
We talked it out and sorted things. Felt calm and glad we stayed friends.
Recorded a new video for my YouTube channel. Editing took hours, but the result looks good. Motivated to post more.
Slept 10 hours, went for a walk in the evening and read a book. Peaceful day.
Sunday planning: the GenAI project is due on 22 November. A bit stressed but I've made a clear plan for each day.
